# NET-002: UFW filters IPv6 when the host has a global IPv6 address

- **Group:** Firewall and exposure
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

With IPV6=no in /etc/default/ufw, UFW writes no ip6tables rules. On a host with a global IPv6 address every service listening on [::] is then open over IPv6 while the IPv4 rules look tight.

## Verify by hand

```sh
grep IPV6 /etc/default/ufw; ip -6 addr show scope global
```

## How to fix it

Set IPV6=yes in /etc/default/ufw, then ufw reload

## What a fix can break

IPv6 services that were reachable only because nothing filtered them stop answering until allowed.
